# 0097 — Fixture: a Proposed ADR

Status: Proposed — awaiting owner sign-off (fixture, for the licence gate's tests)

A stand-in ADR that names the packages a fixture exemption covers but has not been accepted, so an exemption citing it fails the rule that the cited ADR must be Accepted. Its status is the first "Status:" line of its header outside a code fence; the fenced template below quotes an Accepted one, which must not count, even once the line above is deleted.

Packages it names: `fixture-gpl-lib`, `@fixture/ui`.
